note: Receipts for derivative regenerations into this frozen, provenance-managed capture (ADR-0001 §9). This log RECORDS every hand that touches img/ — it is a record, not a guard: nothing consumes it mechanically, and the enforcement that actually fails on a missing or wrong derivative is the crate-mode origin suite (the data-plane sample leg and the PDP pixel legs' broken-image fail-closed guard, which is how the absence this log's first entry repairs was found). The capture itself is receipted by curation.json; entries here cover only re-derivation events, which by the derive contract start at the retained originals, never at Discogs. Every entry must prove add-only (no pre-existing file mutated) and pin the minted bytes to images-index.json.
